 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Bansal
 Order
% 18.12.2023 Crl.M.A. 34851/2023 (Exemption)

1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. The present petition is filed impugning the order dated 31st August, 2023, passed by the Sessions Court, whereby the order of the Trial Court discharging respondents no.3 to 6 for offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) has been upheld.
4. After some hearing, counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the present petition.
5. The present petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
